svg.text: One shared bank · one level a day · ten questions · repeats until the child answers it themselves
final · post-review · 11 blocking findings applied across both system GDDs
Greet · name the streak · name the level and what's left (P4 — unspoken state doesn't exist)
Difficulty lives in the ask, not the question — this is what lets one bank serve ages 3–10
1 attempt per Door, all three in one sitting · 1 re-prompt per Door on silence, which costs a turn but never an attempt
Repeats reopen at Door 1 — the only route by which a HELPED question can ever become SOLO
STT circuit-breaker · door = min(3, max(attempt_no, 1 + stt_flag))
Two garbled reads → the Door is floored at 2, the binary format that survives bad audio. It never adds.
Review fix: the draft formula added stt_flag, pushing a misheard child past the only Door built for them.
M2 · Verdict — only unaided answers clear
M2/M3 · Level End — mastery, and the promise it can end
A shared bank + “repeat until solo” can strand a 3-year-old forever. 3 days is a starting value with a test plan, not a guess.
Safety fix: days_on_level derives from quiz_question_answer, not the attempt log —
that log may fail its write, and the cap would silently never fire. Anchored per run so added questions get a fresh 3 days.
The only place in Quizzy where teaching happens. Reveal tells; this teaches.
1 · the reason — concrete and physical, from authored teach_text
2 · the bridge — a partial statement the child can finish
3 · the handback — the question, reopened. Quizzy never says the answer.
“Four legs on each side, so it can walk right across a web — so how many altogether?”
12–18 words for parts 1+2 — longer isn't heard by a 6-year-old, it's waited through.
Authored, never model-generated. A wrong explanation is worse than none — they remember it.

text.tspan: exchanges = Σ over doors reached (1 + reprompt_used)

svg.text: Worst case 6 per question · 60 per session. Realistic 12–18. p90 target: under 25.
Review fix: the draft claimed 4 and 40 — it counted one re-prompt per question
where three edge cases each grant one per Door. The ceiling was understated by 50%.

tries — counted across days already; within a question, not yet
what the child said · the Door · STT confidence — none exist

svg.text: Observation logs only — quiz_question_answer stays the source of truth.
Reward state never lives in memory/state/
The 48h prune would erase the child's named sound. Streak derives from the
answer log by kid_id — no migration, child-scoped for free (ADR-0008).
The day always ends with a reward
passed or not — failure costs progress, never dignity
The child asks Quizzy anything. CD3+CD4 — and it is also the ad. Ship it alone, first.
4th consumer: the parent app's published API types result as correct|wrong|revealed — renaming verdicts is an external break.
Watch: kid_learning_progress.topic is “<band> level n” — collapsing the band orphans every old achievement row.
Ticket 006 line 15: “Two wrong tries → reveal the answer warmly,
The original design chose flow over mastery, on purpose.
Requirement 4 reverses it — a design change needing ADR-0009, not a fix.
Build order — measure before you enforce
Doors, verdicts, mastery, streak and the day gate are computed server-side. ADR-0005: decide it in code, hand the model a line.
Why this works — Yu-kai Chou, top-10 kids' learning games
Winners run on CD3+CD4. Old Quizzy: one verb, one reward, pure CD2.
